title: Start here
steps: Open your website. Add /owner to the end of its address.
Type your Username and Password. Tap Sign in.
Pick a tab from the menu. On a phone, tap Menu to open the navigation.
Tap Sign out when you are done. Keep your password private.
tip: This guide uses sample people and orders. It never shows your home address.

title: Dashboard
steps: Open Dashboard. Read sales and order counts for the past seven days. Sales include tax.
Read the bake space and work still to do.
Tap an alert to see what needs help.
Open Orders to find a customer. Open Bake & pickup to plan your work.
tip: If payment data will not load, try again. A blank list does not mean there are no orders.

title: Bake & pickup
steps: Open Bake & pickup. Choose the bake you want to work on.
Read Paid, Held in checkout, and Remaining. All three add up to 48 lb. Held means someone is still paying.
Open Bake list. It puts Friday and Saturday orders together. Read each flavor, size, and No ingredient note.
Open Pickups to see Friday morning, Friday afternoon, Saturday morning, and Saturday afternoon. Afternoon starts at noon.
Put the whole pickup order in the porch fridge if it has any chocolate. Put other pickup orders on the porch table. The list tells you which place to use.
After the customer collects the order, tap Mark picked up. Tap Undo completion if you made a mistake.
Use Friday blessing deliveries for gifts. Read the recipient and address. Tap Mark delivered after delivery. Keep the giver’s name private.
Check Confirmation email. If it says error, tap Retry confirmation email. The order is still paid. Never ask the customer to pay again.
tip: Finished pickups, deliveries, and refunds still count in that bake. Do not bake unpaid holds. If payment data will not load, refresh before you bake.

title: Find and finish orders
steps: Open Orders. It starts with outstanding paid orders.
Type a name, phone, email, receipt, or gift recipient. Choose a bake and status if needed. Tap Find orders.
Choose Completed or All paid orders to find old orders. Tap Next or Previous to see more.
Tap Print label beside the item. Mark the pickup or gift done after it is finished. Tap Undo completion to fix a mistake.
If an email failed, the order is still paid. Read the error. Tap Retry confirmation email to try again.
tip: Find practice receipts under Settings. If payment data will not load, try again before you bake.

title: Settings
steps: Open Settings to edit the private pickup address and contact. These details appear only after payment.
The storefront message is the note beside the porch light. Change it and save. This note cannot stop orders or mark a flavor sold out.
Use the links for weekly verses, customer reviews, practice orders, historical rewards and this guide.
tip: Ask for help to change bake days, the 48 lb limit, payments, or tax.

title: Mock orders
steps: Open Settings, then Practice orders. Mock orders do not enter real sales, bake capacity, pickups, or gifts.
Tap Open practice shop or Practice menu. Make sure the page says MOCK before you use it.

Choose items and pickup. Tap Continue to secure payment. The practice screen uses a sample card. Tap Complete practice payment to see what comes next. Or tap Try a declined payment to practice a card problem.
Read the receipt and pickup notes. Tap Preview confirmation email. No charge or email is sent. The tax is just an example.
Find saved practice receipts in Mock orders. Tap Reopen mock confirmation to see one again.
In the practice shop, use Start over for a new empty basket. Leave practice mode before taking a real order.
tip: Never bake or deliver a mock order. The simulation works without Stripe keys. Optional Stripe test checkout needs its own setup.

title: Products & prices
steps: Open Products & prices. Change 3 oz, 8 oz, and 16 oz prices directly in the product list. Prices are before tax.
Clear Available to mark a product sold out. Enter Back on if useful. Check Available to sell it again.
Tap Edit beside a product. Change its name, words, ingredients, allergens, or label pictures. You can also choose No ingredient options and whether it needs the fridge.
Use only omissions that fit the recipe. No shredded coconut still includes coconut oil.
Tap Save products & prices and wait for Saved before leaving.
Tap Add product to make a new one. Check each field before saving. Old paid orders keep the details the customer bought.
Below the list, change the gift surcharge if needed and tap Save gift surcharge. This charge covers the jar and anonymous Friday delivery in Vistancia.
tip: Private pickup details moved to Settings. Friday and Saturday share a 48 lb bake; the cutoff is Tuesday at 9 p.m. Arizona time.

title: Labels
steps: Open Print studio, then Product labels. Or tap Print label beside an item in Orders or Bake & pickup. Its bought recipe and size stay saved, even if you removed that product.
Under Whose order this is, choose the exact item. This fills its flavor, purchased size, and No ingredient choices.
For an extra label, choose a Flavor, then 3 oz, 8 oz, or 16 oz. Gift jars use the same food weight as bags.
Check Ingredients, Allergens, Produced date, and Tracker code. For gifts, use the recipient’s name. Never print the giver’s name.
Tap Save this flavor’s label if you want to keep its words for next time.
Tap Download PNG for T50M Pro. Open the picture in the Katasymbol app.
Choose 50×80 mm tape. Turn the picture sideways if needed. Print one test label. Check that every word fits, then print the rest.
tip: Food weights: 3 oz / 85 g, 8 oz / 227 g, 16 oz / 454 g. Check the order choices again when printing the next item.

title: QR
steps: Open Print studio, then choose this tool.
Tap Download the color QR for a color printer.
Tap Download for the thermal printer for a black and white picture.
Or tap Print tags. A new page opens. Use your browser’s Print button.
Scan one printed code with your phone. Make sure it opens the menu.
tip: Print at actual size. Keep the white space around the code.

title: Thank-you cards
steps: Open Print studio, then choose this tool.
Tap Print eight thank-you cards.
In the new page, open Print. Choose letter paper. Turn off page headers and footers.
Check the preview. Print one sheet. Cut along the dotted lines.
Put one card in each order. Scan a card to check that the review link works.
tip: These cards ask for an honest review. They do not name a gift’s giver.

title: Verse card
steps: Open Settings, then Weekly verse & site verses. You can print the current weekly card directly from Print studio.
Read the verse marked In use. The site picks a new weekly verse on its own.
To change it, type the words and Where it is from. Tap Make this week’s verse.
To go back to the site’s weekly choice, tap Use this week’s verse instead. This button shows only when you have changed the weekly verse.
Tap Print this week’s cards. Check the print preview, print, and cut the cards.
The closing verse on the home and story pages is below. Change it only when needed, then tap Save these verses.
tip: A blessing gift can include the verse the customer chose. Read that gift’s card note in Bake & pickup.

title: Reviews
steps: Open Settings, then Customer reviews, or follow the review alert on Dashboard.
Read the reviews under Waiting on you. They are private until you approve them.
Tap Put it on the site to show a review to customers.
To remove a review, tap Delete for good. Then tap Yes, delete.
Tap Keep it if you change your mind before deleting.
tip: A deleted review cannot be brought back. A review already on the site is marked On the site.

title: Rewards · paused
steps: Open Settings, then Historical reward balances. This page is read-only.
Rewards remain paused. Customers cannot join or earn new points.
Saved point balances remain intact. Ask for help before changing the rewards program.
tip: Pausing rewards does not delete anyone’s saved points.

title: Help
steps: Open Settings, then Pantry guide. Tap a topic to jump to its instructions.
Tap Download the easy guide (PDF) to save a copy.
Open the saved file. Print all pages or just the page you need.
Keep the guide near your packing table. Keep your password and pickup address out of it.
tip: The Help tab and this PDF use the same set of instructions.

title: Your weekly checklist
steps: Check Products & prices, including size prices and Available boxes. Save changes.
Check the verse. Print cards and scan a QR code.
Before baking, refresh Bake & pickup. Read paid weight and the Combined bake list.
Bake and pack by flavor, size, and No ingredient notes. Check every label.
Stock the four pickup groups. Keep chocolate orders in the fridge.
Deliver blessing gifts on Friday. Mark each gift Delivered and each collected order Picked up.
tip: The next bake opens after Tuesday’s 9 p.m. cutoff. A customer who has already started paying may finish during their short payment hold.

title: When something goes wrong
steps: Save did not work: keep the page open. Read the message. Check the fields and try Save again. Wait for Saved.
Payment data did not load: refresh Bake & pickup. If it still fails, ask for help. Do not treat an empty list as proof that there are no orders.
Email failed: use Retry confirmation email in Bake & pickup. The paid order stays paid. If the retry still fails, ask for help and give the order code, never a password.
This bake is full: no more new orders fit. Four pickup groups share the same 48 lb limit.
Checkout is paused: ask for help checking payment, email, and bake space. Do not ask a customer to send card details by text.
Printed words are cut off: check the size in Katasymbol and print one test label again.
tip: When asking for help, say which tab you used and what the message says.
